description.value: Giovane Caffè is an Italian coffee bar offering specialty espresso drinks, Italian-inspired panini, salads, and aperitivi at its downtown Vancouver W Georgia Street location. Part of the KT Restaurants group, it draws on authentic Italian caffè tradition with drinks like the Mandorlatte and Bicerin alongside grab-and-go light fare. The café has both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a pleasant stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, open Italian coffee bar at 418 W Georgia St with a full menu (espresso, panini, salads, aperitivi) and explicit 'Grab-and-go, or linger a little longer' language supporting takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 428-8033 sourced from website for the W Georgia St location only.
